pairs: if you would accept my words,
et mandata mea absconderis penes te:
and conceal my commandments within you,
so that your ears may listen to wisdom,
inclina cor tuum ad cognoscendam prudentiam.
then bend your heart in order to know prudence.
For if you would call upon wisdom
and bend your heart to prudence,
if you will seek her like money,
and dig for her as if for treasure,
then you will understand the fear of the Lord,
and you will discover the knowledge of God.
He will preserve the salvation of the righteous,
and he will protect those who walk in simplicity:
and guarding the ways of sanctity.
If wisdom is to enter into your heart,
and if knowledge is to become pleasing to your soul,
so that you may be rescued from the evil way,
et ab homine qui perversa loquitur;
and from the man who speaks perversities,
qui relinquunt iter rectum, et ambulant per vias tenebrosas;
from those who leave the straight path to walk in dark ways,
who rejoice when they have done evil,
and who exult in the most wicked things.
So may you be rescued from the foreign woman,
et ab extranea quæ mollit sermones suos,
and from the outsider, who softens her speech,
and who leaves behind the Guide of her youth,
et pacti Dei sui oblita est.
and who has forgotten the covenant of her God.
Inclinata est enim ad mortem domus ejus,
For her household inclines toward death,
Omnes qui ingrediuntur ad eam non revertentur,
All those who enter to her will not return again,
nor will they take hold of the paths of life.
So may you walk in the good way,
and keep to the difficult paths of the just.
qui enim recti sunt habitabunt in terra,
For those who are upright shall live upon the earth,
and the simple shall continue upon it.
Yet truly, the impious shall perish from the earth,
et qui inique agunt auferentur ex ea.
and those who act unjustly shall be taken away from it.
